contract: Use Req directly for an HTTP client request with explicit retry, redirect, body and timeout choices.
limits: Local HTTP success/503 are tested; timeout is a deterministic adapter injection.
No server, SSE, WebSocket, SSRF policy, durable effects, circuit breaker or job integration is provided.
Req brings Finch transitively; Elzoo does not expose a second independent HTTP abstraction.

grounding.claim: The named scenarios in this ExUnit file are executable evidence, not universal proofs.
Relies on the pinned provider implementation and public contract.

telemetry.contract: This scoped callable has no independent running lifecycle; the invoking Unit or Assembly owns instrumentation.

config.contract: The caller supplies explicit per-call settings shown by the recipe; no persistent live configuration state is supplied.

control.contract: This scoped callable has no independent runtime lifecycle to pause, drain or resume.
